name: ai-teaching-assistant
description: AI Teaching Assistant with Voice Agent & 3D Avatar

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend/node-service install && pip install -r backend/python-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend/node-service"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend/node-service
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend/node-service && pytest backend/python-service/tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend/node-service
